description: 방송미디어통신위원회_방송시장 경쟁상황 평가 현황 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 방송시장을 유형별(OTT, 이용자, 광고주, 외주제작사, 유료방송서비스이용자)로 구분하고, 시장별로 사업자 수, 점유율 등 경쟁상황 평가 결과를 수록. 이번 평가는 방송사업자 재산상황공표집과 회계보고서, 방송산업 실태조사보고서 등 미디어 시장 관련 자료를 활용하고 이용자‧제작사‧광고주 등의 설문조사를 거... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 방송미디어통신위원회. Its tags are 방송시장, 경쟁상황, 방송시장유형별, 사업자수, 점유율. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
